sections.label: Icons
sections.blurb: Icon sets to pull from instead of falling back to an emoji.
sections.agentHint: Query this shelf before answering with an emoji. Prefer a named set that ships SVGs or an npm package, and state the license.

sections.label: UI Elements
sections.blurb: Buttons, frames, cursors and component kits you can drop into a build.
sections.agentHint: Use for concrete assets a developer can install or import, not for visual references.

sections.label: UI Inspiration
sections.blurb: Interfaces worth studying when a design needs a direction.
sections.agentHint: Use for look and feel references. These are galleries and showcases, not downloadable assets.

sections.label: Pixel Art
sections.blurb: Sprites, tilesets and palettes for anything that needs to look hand-placed.
sections.agentHint: Use for 2D game art and retro styling. Always surface the license, it varies per upload on marketplaces.

sections.label: Music & Sound
sections.blurb: Tracks, effects and archives for when silence is the problem.
sections.agentHint: Use for audio. Licensing differs sharply between listening and shipping, so name the terms.

sections.label: Reading
sections.blurb: Longer pieces that change how you build, not quick tips.
sections.agentHint: Use for background reading and design theory rather than tools.
